# Legal Process Outsourcing | Lexocrates

> Lexocrates is an AI-powered Legal Process Outsourcing (LPO) firm delivering scalable legal research, contract review, and eDiscovery for law firms and in-house corporate legal teams across the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada.

## Core Services

- [Services Overview](https://www.lexocrates.com/services): End-to-end legal support workflows.
- [Legal Research & Writing](https://www.lexocrates.com/services/legal-research-writing): Reliable, multi-jurisdictional research, case law analysis, and memo drafting.
- [Litigation Support](https://www.lexocrates.com/services/litigation-support): Pleading preparation, trial notebooks, exhibits, and docket management.
- [Contract Lifecycle Management](https://www.lexocrates.com/services/contract-review-management): Playbook-driven redlining, extraction, and compliance auditing.
- [eDiscovery & Document Review](https://www.lexocrates.com/services/ediscovery-document-review): Multi-tiered document review, privilege logs, and production assistance.
- [Compliance & Regulatory Support](https://www.lexocrates.com/services/compliance-regulatory-support): Cross-border regulatory monitoring and governance alignment.

## Commercial & Pricing Models

- [LexPack™ & Pricing](https://www.lexocrates.com/pricing): Fixed-price per-assignment work or prepaid LexPack™ legal capacity with a 7% to 28% pricing advantage.
- [Lextimator™ Engine](https://www.lexocrates.com/pricing): AI-powered scoping tool to estimate effort, turnaround, and cost upfront.
